name: glimt
description: A quiet side pane: what this session is doing now, its plan, its agents as a tree, and every other Claude Code session with theirs

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Notify when a background session starts waiting for you, finishes or fails; only one glimt on the machine does

quietColor.title: Quiet text color
quietColor.description: Hints, counts, times, finished rows and the tree's lines. A theme role such as inactive (the default, Claude Code's color for hints and timestamps), claude or success; or a color: #7aa2f7, rgb(122,162,247), ansi256(110) or ansi:cyan

markColor.title: Mark color
markColor.description: The ☐ of a step to do and the ○ of another session that is idle or done, or of one of its agents gone quiet, also on the lines that fold them (☐ 3 more, ○ 2 idle); the other marks keep their status colors. A theme role such as inactive (the default) or claude; or a color: #7aa2f7, rgb(122,162,247), ansi256(110) or ansi:cyan

headingColor.title: Heading color
headingColor.description: The section headings: Now, Plan, Agents and Sessions, and Task and Activity inside an agent or a session. By default bold in the terminal's own text color. A theme role such as claude or success; or a color: #7aa2f7, rgb(122,162,247), ansi256(110) or ansi:cyan

bandColor.title: Cursor band color
bandColor.description: The band that marks the row you left while the keyboard is at the prompt or in one of glimt's forms; otherwise the row's name is inverse. A theme role such as userMessageBackground (the default, the background behind your messages) or selectionBg; or a color: #7aa2f7, rgb(122,162,247), ansi256(110) or ansi:cyan
